approvals.title: Approvals & interactions
approvals.description: Review tool executions paused for approval and respond to requests initiated by MCP servers.
approvals.inboxLinkHint: Review pending tool approvals and MCP requests

approval.listDescription: Only requests whose approver audience includes you are shown. A decision applies to the exact bound operation; execution parameters cannot be edited here.
approval.emptyHint: Tool calls that require your approval will appear here.
approval.filteredByExecution: Showing requests for the selected execution.
approval.decisionDescriptionApprove: Approving allows the worker to execute the original tool call with the bound parameters. The approval is recorded against this exact operation and cannot be used for a different request.
approval.decisionDescriptionReject: Rejecting cancels this execution. The original tool call will not run and the conversation continues without the side effect.
approval.reasonPlaceholder: Explain the decision for the audit trail

interaction.listDescription: Sampling and elicitation requests sent by MCP servers to an authorized audience. Responding accepts or declines this request only; it never approves the enclosing tool execution.
interaction.emptyHint: Requests from MCP servers that need your response will appear here.
interaction.samplingDescription: The MCP server asks Clouisle to generate a model response. Accepting authorizes this model call with its token limit; it does not grant tool or connection access.
interaction.formDescription: The MCP server requests structured input. Only the fields below are sent.
interaction.urlDescription: The MCP server requests an external authorization step. Open the page, complete it, then accept or decline.
interaction.urlHint: The link opens in a new tab. Clouisle never receives your credentials from that page.
interaction.secretFieldsBlocked: This request asks for credentials. Clouisle never collects passwords or tokens in an elicitation form; decline it and authorize through the service page instead.
interaction.invalidUrl: The authorization URL is invalid. Decline this request or contact the service owner.
interaction.responseRecorded: Response recorded. Waiting for the server to continue.
interaction.noFields: This request has no fields to fill in.
interaction.connectionLostNotice: The MCP session was lost before a response was returned. No outer tool call will be retried.

chat.approvalDescription: If you allow it, the assistant will perform this action. If you decline, it will not. Check the action and details first.
chat.refreshFailed: Could not refresh the approval status.
chat.interactionDescription: The MCP server is waiting for your response. Responding here never approves the enclosing tool execution.
